title: Nameless Asterism
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Junior-high friends Tsukasa, Nadeshiko and Mikage are inseparable, but Tsukasa secretly has a crush on Nadeshiko, who has a crush on Mikage, who has a secret of her own. The series follows a tangle of first loves, mostly between girls, and how the friends handle hidden feelings without breaking their friendship.
life_message: Honesty about one's feelings, offered with care for friends, matters more than keeping things comfortable.

content.note: Emotional tension of secrets among friends.
Junior-high crushes, mostly between girls (AniList Yuri, LGBTQ+ Themes; MU Shoujo Ai, Shounen Ai subplot); MangaDex safe.

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Conflicts are emotional and talked through among friends, not answered as insults.

Order vs freedom.evidence: Characters weigh personal feelings against keeping the group intact.

Civic vs kin.evidence: Friend group loyalty outweighs family; twin sibling ties appear (MU).

folkways.japan: Reluctance to voice feelings for fear of disturbing a group's harmony reflects common Japanese school-friendship norms.
